title: Elements of a filtered colimit of sets
statement: Let $\mathcal J$ be a small filtered category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] and $M:\mathcal J\to\textit{Sets}$ a functor with colimit $(L,(\iota_j)_j)$. Then: (1) every element of $L$ is $\iota_j(x)$ for some $j\in\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal J)$ and $x\in M(j)$; (2) for $x\in M(j)$, $x'\in M(j')$ one has $\iota_j(x)=\iota_{j'}(x')$ if and only if there are $k$ and morphisms $\phi:j\to k$, $\phi':j'\to k$ with $M(\phi)(x)=M(\phi')(x')$; (3) for $x,y\in M(j)$ one has $\iota_j(x)=\iota_j(y)$ if and only if there is a morphism $\phi:j\to k$ with $M(\phi)(x)=M(\phi)(y)$.

source.place: Section Tag 04AX (section-directed-colimits), the description of a filtered colimit of sets after Definition Tag 002V ('two elements are equal in the colimit if and only if they eventually become equal')
